title: Hat of Uninhibited Kushigo

sources.title: Lay Bare Their Weakness
markers: | summary = '''Lay Bare Their Weakness''' is a passive feature that increases the difficulty to resist the wearer's spells.

summary: Dealing damage with a melee unarmed attack gives +1 spell save DC until the start of your next turn.

fields.Limits: The bonus does not stack. Throw attacks do not trigger it.
fields.Base value: 240 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
